reader_summary.headline: This is Zack Fuss, an investor at Irenic Capital, and today we’re breaking down MTN Group.
reader_summary.overview: This is Zack Fuss, an investor at Irenic Capital, and today we’re breaking down MTN Group. MTN is the largest mobile network operator in Africa and one of the 10 largest in the world. To break down MTN, I’m joined by Benjamin Isaac, founder and Chief Investment Officer at Brizo Capital.

key_points.text: We unpack their mobile money business in some detail, contrast the development of Telcos in Africa with what we’ve experienced in the US.
Please enjoy this breakdown of MTN.
